fresh_measurements: Each complete E2E run executes chat.spec.ts frame/first-token gates and performance.spec.ts with unchanged thresholds. performance-*.json is emitted by performance.spec.ts. The 4B final report additionally archives raw phase-1 frames-*.json and first-token-*.json from its final complete run; frame summaries are computed from those raw arrays.
